mapper.insert: insert into privacy_delete_job ( job_id, tenant_id, app_id, user_id, scope, status, affected_count, requested_by, reason, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{jobId}, #{tenantId}, #{appId}, #{userId}, #{scope}, #{status}, #{affectedCount}, #{requestedBy}, #{reason}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )
